T: So long, partner. Pass the snacks.
D: Andy's toys end up at a daycare centre run by a bear who smells of strawberries.
P: Serve dessert when the toys meet the strawberry-scented bear.
S: Flour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, cut in wedges, fresh salsa
Flour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges. Salsa.
Puff pastry spirals with tomato relish, ham and cheddar

Puff pastry rolled with leg ham, cheddar and a little tomato relish, sliced into spirals and baked crisp and golden, easy for small hands. Heat the oven to 200C. Lay 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry flat and spread each with 1 tbsp tomato relish. Cover with 4 slices of leg ham and 60g grated cheddar. Roll up tightly from one edge, chill for 15 minutes, then cut each log into 10 slices. Lay flat on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Bonnie's tea party jam and cream scones
playtime with the toys in Bonnie's room

Little buttermilk scones baked tall and golden, split warm and piled with strawberry jam and softly whipped cream for a pretend tea party. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk with a knife until it just comes together. Pat to 3cm thick, cut 12 small rounds with a floured cutter and pack close together on a lined tray. Brush with milk and bake for 12 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and 200ml cream whipped soft.
M: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce over spaghetti, extra parmesan
Spaghetti and meatballs: beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
College road trip chicken Caesar wraps

Grilled garlic chicken, crisp cos, bacon bits and parmesan tossed in a creamy Caesar dressing, rolled in soft tortillas and wrapped tight for the drive. Toss 600g chicken thigh fillets with oil, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and grill for 5 minutes a side, then rest and slice. Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and chop. Whisk 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 small grated garlic clove and 30g grated parmesan. Toss 1 shredded cos lettuce with the dressing, bacon and chicken. Fill 4 large tortillas, roll up tight and wrap in baking paper, then halve.
W: Warm biscuits split and filled with sugared strawberries and cream
Buttery shortcake rounds baked at 200C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar.
K: Strawberries, vanilla ice cream, milk and malt powder blended thick and pink

Fresh strawberries blended thick with vanilla ice cream, cold milk and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream and a halved strawberry. Hull 300g ripe strawberries, keeping 2 for garnish. Blend the rest with 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey until thick and pink. Pour into 4 glasses, top with whipped cream and half a strawberry each.
